subject: POC headroom request — late-evening throughput soak
body:
From: Tim Groves <tim@edgechat.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Evening soak — temporary headroom request for POC

Hi Rachel,

We're ramping the EdgeChat POC tonight for a late-evening throughput soak (11pm–5am PT) to validate tail-latency under steady concurrent traffic. Goal: sustain ~120 rps, ~3M tokens over 6 hours, with 99.9th percentile latency target under 600ms. Our engineers saw throttling in prior runs around 50k tokens/hour.

Can Redwood provision a short-lived allowance (top-up) and extend the trial window by 72 hours so we can complete the run and collect evals? Attached is the load plan & sequence. If it helps, we'll keep a one-line status in the thread during the run.

Attachments: edgechat_poc_loadplan_v2.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Groves
Head of Platform
EdgeChat

---
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Groves <tim@edgechat.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening soak — temporary headroom request for POC

Thanks for the plan, Tim — looks thorough. Two quick clarifying items before I route for approval:

- Confirm expected peak concurrency in tokens/sec and whether the 3M token figure is a conservative upper bound or expected consumption.
- Any compliance notes we should log for the short extension (particularly if production data will be used)?

Looping in Karthik and Marissa to expedite — this is time-sensitive for tonight. I'll push to Finance/Promo if we can justify a one-off allowance.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening soak — temporary headroom request for POC

Thanks — Rachel and Tim. I reviewed the load plan. If EdgeChat needs a night window we can offer a temporary promo top-up:

- Proposal: 4M token allowance (one-off) + 72-hour trial extension tied to this run.
- Condition: Redwood support engineer on-call for the window; EdgeChat provides an on-call Slack contact.

Marissa, any objections from a pipeline/accounting perspective? Stephanie, can we approve a promo voucher for D-2027-0891? If not, what discount/limit should we set?

Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening soak — temporary headroom request for POC

Approved per pipeline play: issue a 4,000,000 token promo voucher scoped to EdgeChat (deal D-2027-0891), valid from 2027-09-14T22:00:00-07:00 through 2027-09-18T22:00:00-07:00 (72-hour extension included).

Notes:
- Approval reason: clear evaluation objective, reasonable ask for a final soak, expected to accelerate close.
- SLA: Redwood will assign a support engineer (on-call) for the 11pm–5am run window and monitor RMU usage.
- Billing: Voucher will not be charged; if consumption exceeds 4M tokens, usage will revert to standard trial rates and notify the AE.

Attachment: promo-approval-stub.png (image/png) — internal approval record.

Stephanie Nguyen
Manager, Growth Finance

---
From: Tim Groves <tim@edgechat.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@edgechat.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evening soak — temporary headroom request for POC

Amazing — thank you, Rachel/Karthik/Stephanie. Confirming we'll run tonight at 23:00 PT and keep Redwood on the Slack channel (#edgechat-poc). We'll aim for the 3M token target but will throttle gracefully if needed.

I'll upload a short post-run summary and latency plots to the shared Drive link. Please ping me at +1-415-555-0198 if anything unexpected pops up.

Regards,
Tim

---
Thread notes: voucher created in billing console for deal D-2027-0891; on-call rotation notified; AE (Rachel) to post run summary and update HubSpot record.
